name: Lane
description: Lane is a website template for driving schools, with a licence category switch that filters course start dates, price packages and the sign-up form at once, a step by step route to the licence with time and cost, instructors and first-attempt pass rates. Graphite asphalt, a green go light and the bold Unbounded typeface give the website a confident, road-ready character. Replace the copy, photos, school details, prices and reviews with your own before publishing.
features: Licence category switch shared by the start dates, price tabs and form
Course start dates board with free seats and a waiting list
Route to the licence in six stops, each with time and cost
Course pages with a week by week plan
Pass rates compared with the exam centre average
Student and parent reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
Mobile menu with the nearest course start
